title: The template-picker browser fixture supplies the build reply envelope so explicit CMS selection, accepted completion and free cancellation remain tested without page errors
steps: S1: Run the actual TemplatePicker, row action and RevisionView in the existing browser fixture at 1440px and 390px.
S2: Select each supported CMS, cancel the row picker and revision picker, then accept the revision build.
expect: S1: The selected CMS, design and quickstart are handed to the recording API and the preview closes.

S2: Cancel creates no build and no Details navigation; accepting the revision build calls completion once, keeps its label, emits no page error and makes no Add site or chat HTTP write in this picker-only fixture.
evidence: Release #1622 CI run 39893172612 failed at template-picker.test.mjs:176: the fixture returned ok without body, while runAction reads body.actions. The fixture now returns the established actions/usage envelope; no production request path is changed.
fence: Real browser components against local recording fixtures. This isolates template choice and completion; native demo-chat sending and paid builds are outside this case.

tests: Build opens the existing preview, chooses CMS without Add site/chat writes, and cancel is free on desktop/mobile
